checks.name: R67 additive isolated schema applies twice without replacing R64/R65
R67 table enables RLS as defense in depth
anonymous and authenticated roles cannot read the table or execute either RPC
service role has no update or delete privilege on accepted private batches
real independent connections admit one whole batch and one idempotent duplicate
database roundtrip retains original actions, both signatures and the first receipt exactly
later verification cannot rewrite the original receipt timestamp
conflicting replay compares both signatures rather than accepting matching payload digests alone
receipt provenance binding cannot change on replay
sessions start at one and cannot skip unacknowledged or expired predecessors
session capture time cannot move backwards
the exact next signed sequence is admitted after its predecessor
a previously committed operation cannot be resigned under another session
scope/source parameters are explicit and cross-scope reads do not return another source history
real PostgreSQL clock rejects expired or future-dated admission even when receipt is internally coherent
SQL independently rejects matching null fields, duplicate scenario IDs and invalid optional scenario shape
SQL requires string digests rather than accepting numeric text coercion
native action safety, synthetic invariants and separate policy version are SQL-enforced
admin storage reads are bounded and reject extra caller-controlled fields
all rejected batches remain atomic and leave exactly two accepted records
complete R64/R65 event, policy, accounting and evolution table snapshots remain unchanged
